review.notes: All 13 physical pages compared against extracted PDF text; page 12 reference block additionally rendered at 300 dpi and visually verified. Code fences are absent and balanced. Unmatched PDF n-grams are figure-internal diagram/chart text (Fig. 2 RL-token diagram, Fig. 4-6 axis ticks), equation math rendered as LaTeX, and the PDF text layer's own broken words (e.g. 'demonstra tion', 'rein forcement') that the OCR correctly joined. Equations (1)-(9), Algorithm 1, Tables I-II content, all sections and the reference list are present. Two reference-URL defects fixed on physical page 12.
